text.p: Westgold Resources NL and Ramsgate Resources NL said on Wednesday they had agreed to a merger.

The merger terms are one fully paid ordinary Westgold share for every eight fully paid Ramsgate ordinary shares, the issue of one listed December 1997 Westgold A$2.50 option for every five Ramsgate listed options, and the issue of one listed Westgold option for every 35 May 28 1997 A$0.20 unlisted options. Westgold currently holds 55.6 percent of Ramsgate and said it intends to vote in favour of the scheme, if able.
The merger, through a scheme of arrangement, is conditional on court, regulatory and shareholder approvals.
Based on closing prices for Westgold of A$0.80 and A$0.10 for Ramsgate, the offer values Ramsgate at A$0.10 per ordinary share.
